انحصرا (form VII)
# اِنْحَصَرَا (inḥaṣarā) /in.ħa.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصِرَا (inḥaṣirā) /in.ħa.sˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
